_: CLAYLIGHT v1 — the frozen style lock for the motion-Shorts lane. Changing any value here is a rebrand, not a tweak. Chosen 2026-08-21 over KAAGAZ (paper-editorial) and LATE SHIFT (desk-world) by a judged panel over hit evidence; hardened with KAAGAZ's provenance strip and LATE SHIFT's screen-embed stack. docs/MOTION-PIPELINE.md PART III.

rules: coral = the carry element ONLY; one coral object per episode; two coral = broken grammar
amber = heat/cost/limit; counters and warning glow
mint = capture-adjacent proof ONLY; mint on a toy alone is illegal
real captures keep native colors, never retinted

type.display: Baloo 2 ExtraBold, uppercase, tracked +2%, chips 1-3 words, >=64px; punch chip = cream-on-coral pill
type.counters: IBM Plex Mono Medium, amber, tabular — renders ONLY measured numbers; mono on an invented number is a QC fail
type.devanagari: Baloo 2 Devanagari, max ONE word per episode, chips only — pending VJ call
type.rule: ALL type on a flat 2D layer above the 3D world; type never enters perspective

materials.sprite_light: baked warm rim light from upper-left in every prompt
materials.shadow: radial ellipse, 25% black, 4:1 squash, auto-drawn by SpriteLayer — non-optional
materials.bind: 2% amber overlay + soft vignette over everything EXCEPT full-frame proof captures; frame-indexed grain ~3%
materials.slab_embed: 0.5px soften on inset capture, 4-8% sheen, blurred 103% light-wrap behind at ~15% screen-blend, dominant-hue radial spill onto adjacent clay at 10-15%, 6f crossfade on capture cuts
materials.provenance: Plex Mono strip under REAL captures only: '✓ REAL CAPTURE · claude.ai · <date>' (mint). Mocks carry NO strip — they declare themselves by design language (clay chrome, skeleton bars, no product UI), which is what keeps them honest without debug-text noise in the film. (VJ storyboard note, 2026-08-21.)

flux.suffix: , cute soft 3D clay render, matte plastic toy, smooth handmade clay texture, single warm rim light from upper left, soft studio shadow, centered, isolated on plain dark background #1A1214, viewed from 35 degrees three-quarter angle, 15 degrees above, 50mm lens, no text, no face, no logo
flux.params: steps 4, 1536x1536, seed family base 331100 (object i = base+i), 3 candidates (seed/+1000/+2000), elect 1, commit forever to assets/claylight/library/
flux.post: rembg + 1px alpha erode + faint inner shadow; generate on stage-matched bg
rules: ONE canonical angle per object — never promise rotation flat sprites cannot render
carry element gets 3 lighting STATES (neutral/amber/mint), never angles
no faces, no googly eyes — props, not characters

camera.rig: perspective 1200; WORLD group; depths FAR -600 / MID -300 / HERO 0 / FORE +150

moves.shelf_dolly: camZ 0->220 over the full beat, strictly linear — the default; frame never static
moves.counterweight_pan: world translateX -60->+60px per beat; chip fires as each toy crosses center
moves.knee_snap: 6f ease-out, scale 1.0->1.18 + rotateX 0->2deg; the knee + <=2 emphasis beats
moves.zoom_through: <=2/ep; ease-in dolly into a foreground sprite's dark center, radial mask reveals next scene; through-object = the coral carry when possible
moves.orbit_nod: world rotateY sine +-6deg, ~5s period, for holds; HARD CAP +-8deg
moves.drop_in: sprite from camera, scale 3->1, 8f overshoot, blur 12->0, shadow fades in 4f AFTER contact

camera.banned: shake, whip pan, handheld noise, non-constant-rate dolly, per-sprite Y rotation, sprite scale >1.4x native, turntables, dynamic sprite lighting, cross-Z contact, camera-tracked cast shadows

diet.real_captures: 30-35% — proof beats slab-flat >=85% width; NEVER zero; provenance strip mandatory
diet.type_overlay_presence: ~90%; a chip event every 0.4-0.7s hot, <=1.9s in holds; >=2 layers acting every frame
diet.code_svg: 15-25% — connective tissue only (counters, shadows, masks, glow), never the proof
